intervention.title: Non-evidence-bound recovery context cannot fake causal concentration
intervention.behavior: Evidence-bound recovery bases keep shared fingerprints. A gate that explicitly says evidence_bound=false is lineage-scoped by job for diversity accounting, so static context similarity cannot masquerade as causal concentration. Missing/legacy basis semantics keep the existing fail-safe rescue behavior.

verification.conclusion: EFF070 removed the LOCAL-BATCH duplicate recovery rows and cleared the live rescue trigger before EFF071 publication.

experiment.note: RESCUE_FIRST selected the rescue mechanism promptly; authority still came only from the Guide PIN. No causal performance winner is inferred from this single slot.

truth_boundary: Runtime evidence confirms EFF070's live effect. EFF071 is static-guarded but not yet runtime-observed from a published allocator source containing its implementation; it must not be called RATCHETED yet.
